storage: private D1; bodies in private R2

reviews.description: Review identity, versioned protocol and explicit activation boundary.

scholarly_works.description: Neutral intellectual work, never an included source by definition.

agents.description: Named people, organisations and software, without inferred identity.

publication_venues.description: Journal, edited volume, series or conference containing an expression.

expressions.description: Content/language version with version-specific bibliographic coordinates.

contributions.description: Ordered author/editor/translator role and attributed affiliation.

document_sections.description: Ordered, located parts of a scientific publication; no section is assumed to exist.

publication_declarations.description: Source-attributed funding, ethics, conflict and availability declarations.

manifestations.description: Located digital embodiment, acquired bytes and rights distinct from a locator.

bibliographic_identifiers.description: A sourced identifier of exactly one bibliographic entity; equality does not infer a merge.

metadata_assertions.description: Immutable field assertion preserving conflicting source values.

citation_relations.description: Directional citing/cited relation with reference evidence, not a similarity recommendation.

work_relations_v2.description: Attributed identity, derivation or correction relation.

review_candidates.description: Membership in one review with optimistic concurrency; no inherited legacy decision.

legacy_references.description: Historical cross-reference only, excluded from V2 deduplication and eligibility.

retrieval_attempts.description: Immutable outcome of a real retrieval attempt including failure.

evidence_sources.description: Private acquired source with identity, kind, rights and content hash.

evidence_spans.description: Offsets and locator over one immutable source snapshot.

decision_proposals.description: Immutable preparatory four-criterion payload, awaiting exact-hash human PR approval.

approval_receipts.description: Verified human GitHub review of the exact proposal and head commit.

screening_decisions_v2.description: Human-approved scientific outcome with append-only supersession.

criterion_assessments.description: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN with source spans and specific reasoning.

assistant_observations.description: Model observation with input hash and prompt/model version; never a decision.

publication_approvals_v2.description: Independent human approval of public fields and publication state.

search_days.description: Every expected Rome calendar day, including absent and failed execution.

run_attempts.description: Leased execution attempt for a scheduled day; actual timestamps can cross midnight.

query_executions.description: Immutable source/query attempt; exactly one successful checkpoint may count.

discovery_occurrences.description: Every source occurrence, including rediscovery and duplicate occurrences.

outbox.description: Transactional delivery intent; external delivery is idempotent and at least once.

operational_events.description: Append-only technical event, independent from scientific outcomes.

legacy_snapshots.description: Byte-hashed preservation manifest, external-state completeness and restore receipt.

access_assessments_v2.description: Append-only, attributed lawful full-text access verification. OA admission is independent of four-part screening and publication approval.

enrichment_targets.description: Provisional registered-record target; not canonical bibliographic identity.

enrichment_inputs.description: Immutable bibliographic input snapshot from an existing registry.

enrichment_jobs.description: Recoverable, leased work item independent of daily discovery.

enrichment_runs.description: Observed scheduler invocation; no scientific completeness claim.

enrichment_attempts.description: Immutable outcome of an actual enrichment attempt.

enrichment_sources.description: Private source snapshot for an existing record, with content hash and retention basis.

enrichment_citation_observations.description: Provider-attested directed citation between external identifiers, not canonical Work identity.

enrichment_citation_coverage.description: Provider-specific page/checkpoint coverage; not global completeness.

enrichment_proposals.description: Private evidence-grounded extraction; never an approved scientific decision.

enrichment_studies.description: Study reported inside a publication; not the bibliographic Work.

enrichment_datasets.description: Dataset and selection used by a reported study.

enrichment_variable_uses.description: Operationalised variable and role in one particular analysis.

enrichment_findings.description: Individual result grounded in an analysis and source evidence.

enrichment_framework_proposals.description: Proposed role in the six-category medical framework, separate from review screening.

invariants: No migration inserts review, candidate, seed, screening or publication data.
A ScholarlyWork is independent of review membership.
Four criteria require separate source-bound human assessments.
Topics and infiltration relations are multi-label; infiltration relations are not ordinal.
Unknown search counts are null; completed zero-result queries are measured zeros.
Run attempts are immutable after leaving running; an expired third attempt resolves its day to completed, partial or failed from preserved checkpoints, never an indefinite running state.
Activation requires an existing immutable snapshot receipt with complete external state and a verified restore.
Open access requires a lawful anonymous full-text observation, a verified source identity, an accepted or record version, rights provenance and a retained private text hash.
An access observation never supplies scientific eligibility. Revocation supersedes access evidence without rewriting screening history.
Eligible proposals and approval imports bind the exact current OA assessment; publication insertion also requires current OA.

cile_schema_versions.purpose: Technical receipt for a verified applied SQL migration; not a review instance.

v2_open_access_candidates.purpose: Current unsuperseded verified OA assessments joined to the same candidate’s verified full-text evidence; no scientific eligibility inference.
